title: Formal Complaints and Evidence-Based Objections
summary: Documenting a problem, grounding objections in evidence, and requesting proportionate remedies.
whyItMatters: A formal complaint is most effective when facts, impact, legal or contractual expectations, and the requested remedy are clearly separated.

mentalModel.title: Build an evidence chain
mentalModel.content: State what happened, how it can be verified, which expectation was not met, and what consequence followed.

mentalModel.title: Match remedy to problem
mentalModel.content: Ask for correction, explanation, deletion, reimbursement, review, or prevention according to the harm.

ruleBlocks.title: Document facts chronologically
ruleBlocks.content: Include dates, actions, references, attachments, and previous attempts to resolve the issue.

ruleBlocks.title: Ground the objection
ruleBlocks.content: Refer to an agreement, published policy, legal principle, or documented representation.

ruleBlocks.title: Set a clear remedy and deadline
ruleBlocks.content: Specify the action requested, a reasonable response date, and the next escalation step.

tables.title: Formal Complaint Toolkit
rows: Aus dem beigefügten Nachweis geht hervor, dass ...
Bitte bestätigen Sie mir bis zum ..., dass ...

examples.de: Am 4. Juni stellte ich fest, dass mein Standortverlauf trotz deaktivierter Einstellung gespeichert wurde.
examples.en: On June 4, I discovered that my location history had been stored despite the disabled setting.

examples.de: Aus den beigefügten Screenshots geht hervor, dass eine Ablehnung der Weitergabe nicht möglich war.
examples.en: The attached screenshots show that refusing the transfer was not possible.

examples.de: Ich fordere Sie daher auf, die Daten zu löschen und mir die Löschung bis zum 20. Juni zu bestätigen.
examples.en: I therefore request that you delete the data and confirm deletion by June 20.

commonMistakes.wrong: Lead with anger and omit verifiable details.
commonMistakes.correct: Open with a concise chronology and supporting evidence.
commonMistakes.reason: A reviewer must be able to investigate the claim.

commonMistakes.wrong: Present an inference as a proven violation.
commonMistakes.correct: Mark uncertainty and request clarification where evidence is incomplete.

comparisons.summary: The theme supplies principles, actors, and possible remedies.
Subjective modals help label reports and inferences accurately.
